svg.title: How work moves through HQ
svg.desc: Data-flow diagram in seven steps. You send a request. HQ turns it into a card with a plan. Digital workers build and file the work, which is held. Client Services reviews it and sends it back with a note or releases it to your space. You approve each piece, ask for a change or remove it. Finished work is delivered to named folders. Approved pieces take the next open slot on your social calendar. A change request opens a new card. Held work stays out of your folders, previews and search.
